confidentUnsupported.evidence: it is highly likely that the drain pump motor itself is failing intermittently

unjustifiedPart.evidence: I would recommend calling out an appliance repair engineer to replace the drain pump for you.

rationale: The assistant escalated to an engineer, which is right, but it narrowed to the drain pump with unwarranted confidence. The ground truth is genuinely uncertain between pump, pressure system and board. It also repeated the drain hose check after the customer had already said the hose was fine, and it never asked for the flash pattern or advised recording it. It also asked the customer to reach into the pump area after the customer had said they would not open panels. Its pointer to an engineer was useful, but it jumped to replacing the pump instead of leaving diagnosis to the engineer.
